sectors.ai: Indonesia's tech sector is surging on global AI-driven semiconductor demand, with memory and equipment leaders like SK Hynix (+27.6%) and Samsung (+24.6%) signaling a durable upcycle. The ALERT signal suggests near-term volatility, but structural AI capex supports continued outperformance.
